newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's share index soars in hectic trade. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's share index soars in hectic trade. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: Bahrain's share index climbed 72.59 points to a new record high this week in hectic trading focused on bank shares, official figures showed on Thursday.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said the index ended the week at 1,454.86 points, up from 1,382.27 points a week earlier.
Trading volume rose sharply to 22.85 million shares -- the highest level since the bourse was established eight years ago -- from 10.58 million shares the previous week.

The bourse said Bahrain International Bank (BIB) shares dominated this week's trading with more than 11.9 million shares worth 1.6 million dinars ($4,244,031) changing hands. BIB gained 34 fils this week to close at 145 fils on Thursday. (Corrects Bahrain International Bank figures)
Shares of 21 firms of the 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 357 transactions.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
